tree.text: An agency shall not abolish any position occupied by an employee in order to make the duties of such position available to be performed on a part-time career employment basis.
Any person who is employed on a full-time basis in an agency shall not be required to accept part-time employment as a condition of continued employment.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1978—Pub. L. 95–454 renumbered section 3393 of this title as this section.
